summary: Comprehensive mobile functional sweep of Wayly Expo web preview (login cathy@example.com, Family plan, 3 participants). Ran real submissions against every AI tool, walked the guided workflows, exercised Stripe checkout, opened every Settings/Your Account subscreen and swept ~25 screens for blank/crash/$$/%%. Result: no P0 crashes or blank screens; all 9 AI tools produce sensible output; Stripe test-mode checkout opens successfully. Found 3 P1 parity/consistency gaps (Classification Self-Check generic labels, Family plan participant-count copy inconsistency across plan-select vs plan-billing vs participants list, dark-mode CTA text contrast) and 2 P2 polish issues (AI dollar formatting with space after comma, Rules-of-Hooks in tool/[slug].tsx). Full details below.

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard 'Upload a Statement' CTA in DARK MODE
ui_bugs.issue: In dark mode the Pressable renders bg=rgb(165,81,43) (terracotta) but the child text color computes to rgb(0,0,0) black — low contrast, and inconsistent with light mode which is white-on-teal (verified iter174). Expected: white/high-contrast text on the coloured CTA regardless of theme. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx dashboard-upload-cta + /app/mobile/src/components/ui.tsx T colour fallback in dark palette.

12 scale rows are labelled generically 'Area 1' … 'Area 12' with no domain description. Web version uses meaningful domain labels (Self-care, IADLs, Cognition and behaviour, Safety, Informal support, Home environment, Mood — see /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/ClassificationCheck.jsx L144-152). Users on mobile cannot answer accurately because they don't know what each Area represents. PARITY GAP vs web.

integration_issues.flow: Ask Wayly chat AI response formatting
integration_issues.issue: Response text contains dollar amounts with a space after the comma, e.g. '$86, 185.23' and '$137, 917.01' — likely a punctuation artifact from the LLM that sanitizeAI() is not stripping. Should render as '$86,185.23'.

issues: /plan-select — Family card: '2 PARTICIPANTS · UP TO 3 CAREGIVER SEATS'
/participants — banner: 'Family plan covers 2, additional participants are $24.50 per fortnight each'
Three different participant limits shown to the same user in the same plan. Pick one canonical number (business-defined) and align copy across all 3 screens.

Bullet says 'Track two parents on one plan' which reinforces the /plan-select '2 participants' rule, but /plan-billing bullet says 'Up to 4 participants'. Same inconsistency; also fix copy tone (two parents vs 4 participants).

parity_issues.issue: Mobile uses 12 generic 'Area N' scales; web asks domain-specific questions grouped by self_care/iadl/cognition_behaviour/safety_hospitalisation/informal_support/home_environment/mood.
parity_issues.expected: Same domain-based questionnaire on mobile as on web (identify each scale row with a meaningful label + help text).
parity_issues.actual: 'Area 1' through 'Area 12' with no help text, all 0-4 scales visually identical.

parity_issues.issue: Different participant limit shown on plan-select (2) vs plan-billing (Up to 4) vs participants list banner (2).
parity_issues.expected: Canonical, identical copy across all plan/billing screens on mobile and web.
parity_issues.actual: Three conflicting numbers on three consecutive mobile screens.

action_items: P1 — Rebuild Classification Self-Check on mobile with the same 12 domain-labelled questions the web tool uses (map to self_care / iadl / cognition_behaviour / safety_hospitalisation / informal_support / home_environment / mood). Replace 'Area N' with the descriptive label and add the same help copy.

P1 — Align Family plan participant-limit copy across /plan-select, /plan-billing, and /participants (business decision required: is Family plan 2, 3, or 4 included seats?). Whichever is canonical, all three screens must match.

P1 — Investigate dark-mode CTA text colour: 'Upload a Statement' renders black text on terracotta bg in dark mode (rgb(0,0,0) on rgb(165,81,43)). Ensure the same white-text-on-coloured-CTA rule that was fixed in iter173 for light-mode teal also applies for the terracotta variant in dark mode. Likely another <T> colour fallback edge case in ui.tsx or dark-palette colours.primaryFg.

P2 — sanitizeAI (/app/mobile/src/utils/format.ts or equivalent) should collapse a space that appears immediately after a comma inside numeric strings so LLM output '$86, 185.23' → '$86,185.23'. Also apply on web for parity.

P2 — Fix Rules-of-Hooks violation in /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx: an early return of <StatementDecoderTool /> is placed at L193 BEFORE useState calls at L194-197. Extract the remaining form-tool body into its own component or move all useState calls above the branching return.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx L188-217 mixes early return + useState in the same functional component: `if (slug === 'statement-decoder') return <StatementDecoderTool />;` sits on L193, but L194-197 declare useState hooks unconditionally. This works today because the slug is stable per route, but it is a Rules-of-Hooks footgun and will crash if the slug ever changes at runtime. Extract the form-tool body into a separate component (`FormTool`) and render <StatementDecoderTool /> or <FormTool /> from the top of ToolScreen without any hooks in the outer switch.

/app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx classification-self-check config only carries a single scale12 field labelled 'Rate each area (0 = no help, 4 = full help)' and no per-scale labels — mobile parity requires either a bespoke ClassificationSelfCheckTool component (like StatementDecoderTool) or a scale12 schema that carries 12 domain-labelled rows.

Family-plan copy is currently duplicated in ≥3 places on mobile (plan-select cards, plan-billing card, participants banner). Extract to a single source-of-truth constant so a single change propagates.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-focused sweep; all mobile API-backed flows returned real data)
success_rate.frontend: 9/9 AI tools return output, 9/9 Settings subscreens open, ~25/25 drawer screens load, Stripe test checkout opens. 3 P1 + 2 P2 issues found.

Per-participant isolation confirmed: making Robert primary re-scopes dashboard header. No blank/crashed screens; no '$$' or '%%' anywhere.
rca of the issue: P1 Classification Self-Check parity gap: /app/mobile/app/tool/[slug].tsx L38-41 declares the tool as a single scale12 field with `label: 'Rate each area (0 = no help, 4 = full help)'` and no per-scale labels. The rendered FormRow for scale12 auto-names each row 'Area 1' … 'Area 12'. The web version (/app/frontend/src/pages/tools/ClassificationCheck.jsx L144-152) uses named domains (self_care, iadl, cognition_behaviour, safety_hospitalisation, informal_support, home_environment, mood). Fix by either extending scale12 config to accept 12 explicit row labels + help text, or by adding a bespoke ClassificationSelfCheckTool similar to StatementDecoderTool. Same applies to any future domain-based tool that needs per-scale copy.
